allowed.reason: Message.stop_details is required and nullable in anthropic-sdk-typescript (src/resources/messages/messages.ts) and null for every stop reason but refusal (platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback); this documentation example predates the field

Message.container is required and nullable in the Messages API reference (platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/messages/create) and null unless a container tool ran; the recorded responses in stream-text-recorded and thinking-text-recorded (2026-09-28) carry it; this documentation example predates the field

Message.diagnostics is required and nullable in the Messages API reference, and the 2026-09-23 API release note says POST /v1/messages responses always include it, null when the request did not include the diagnostics object; the recorded responses in stream-text-recorded and thinking-text-recorded (2026-09-28) carry it; this documentation example predates the field
